svg.title: Skiff 0.1.0 and similar software, measured
svg.desc: Skiff 0.1.0: memory, physical footprint 146 MiB, processes 1, idle cpu 0.1%. Terminal UI client: memory, physical footprint 397 MiB, processes 2, idle cpu 16.2%. Electron-based client: memory, physical footprint 893 MiB, processes 6, idle cpu 7.9%. Measured 2026-11-24 on an Apple M1 Pro Mac (macOS, arm64); on the Mac's own display. Local kwok test cluster: 100 nodes, 5,415 pods, the same cluster for every row. Each app has its pod list open and loaded. Memory is the physical footprint that Activity Monitor shows, not PSS (macOS has none): not comparable with the Linux figures. Each value is the median of three runs; only the medians were recorded, not the smallest and largest run. Terminal UI client: ran inside a minimal wrapper with no terminal app around it; a real terminal would add to its numbers. Electron-based client: ran in a fresh, empty profile limited to the test cluster.
